Plan a new cycle from a goal (DEPRECATED: use `sddk plan workitem` instead)

Usage: sddk plan [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  work-item  Manage planning work items
  dep        Manage planning dependencies between work items
  evidence   Attach evidence to a work item
  decision   Record a decision for a work item
  graph      Show the planning graph identity and provenance chain for a cycle
  import     Import the EXECUTION-SPINE.yaml into the planning ledger
  roadmap    Roadmap decision-plane projections (status, next, blocked, show, graph)
  help       Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --root <ROOT>
          Checkout or worktree root. When absent and `--no-infer` is not set, the cycle inference layer walks up from cwd searching for a project marker (sddk manifest, .git, AGENTS.md). When `no_infer` is true, this must be provided explicitly

      --scope <SCOPE>
          Required monorepo scope, using `.` for the repository root. When absent and `--no-infer` is not set, inferred from the resolved root

      --remote <REMOTE>
          Explicit remote URL instead of read-only Git discovery

      --fallback-seed <FALLBACK_SEED>
          Stable UUID for a repository without a remote

      --no-infer
          Opt out of context inference. When set, `--root` and `--scope` must be passed explicitly and `--cycle` is a required argument on cycle commands

      --name <NAME>
          Legacy: display name used to derive the stable cycle identifier. DEPRECATED — emits warning and delegates to `cycle start`

      --path <PATH>
          Legacy: workflow path applied to the cycle
          
          [possible values: a-min, a-lite, a-full, b-direct]

      --branch <BRANCH>
          Legacy: git branch associated with the cycle

      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format

          Possible values:
          - text: Human-friendly text rendering
          - json: Machine-readable JSON envelope
          
          [default: text]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')
